name: Theme Toggle
job: Let a reader switch a dark kit page to light and back, follow the system setting until they choose, and print on paper colours.

anatomy.role: Sans, body size, text only, 44px tall target; label names the mode it switches to
Overrides the kit surface, text and signal tokens on `:root`; kit parts stay verbatim
`prefers-color-scheme: light` applies the remap unless the reader chose dark
Print always uses the light remap and hides the button
Pre-paint head script reads the saved choice; the tail script saves it under a per-page key

states.name: Dark (default)
states.note: The kit as authored. Button reads Light mode.

states.name: Light (chosen)
states.note: Remap on, data-theme set to light. Button reads Dark mode.

states.name: No script
states.note: The button stays hidden; the page still follows the system setting through the media query.

use_when: A dark kit page will be read by a counterpart who may prefer light, or will be printed.
The page inlines the kit tokens, so one remap covers every part on it.
avoid_when: The page is a video frame or a fixed-render surface; a frame has one look.
The page already has its own light palette under page-local token names (the myally family uses `--pg-*`); keep that one.

data.note: The localStorage key for the saved choice, one per page family, such as `brooksTheme`.

access: A real `<button>`, hidden until the script runs, so it never shows without working.
`aria-label` says Switch to light mode or Switch to dark mode; the visible label matches.
Focus ring is a 2px cyan outline; the target is 44px tall.
The light remap keeps every kit pairing at AA contrast (checked on the Brooks one-pager by page_gate).
gates: `scripts/kit_primitive_sync.py --check`: every page that marks this block carries it unchanged.
`scripts/page_gate.py`, `scripts/token_source_gate.py`, and the Impeccable detector at 0 findings.
tail_js: <script>(function(){var d=document.documentElement,b=document.getElementById('themebtn');if(!b)return;var mq=window.matchMedia?matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: light)'):null;function cur(){var t=d.getAttribute('data-theme');if(t)return t;return mq&&mq.matches?'light':'dark';}function label(){b.textContent=cur()==='light'?'Dark mode':'Light mode';b.setAttribute('aria-label','Switch to '+b.textContent.toLowerCase());}b.hidden=false;label();b.addEventListener('click',function(){var n=cur()==='light'?'dark':'light';d.setAttribute('data-theme',n);try{localStorage.setItem('{key}',n);}catch(e){}label();});if(mq&&mq.addEventListener)mq.addEventListener('change',label);})();</script>
